title: convergence_by_mobility_class.tsv
description: Row schema for convergence_by_mobility_class.tsv. Tab-separated, UTF-8, LF, header row required.

mobility_category.description: predicted_conjugative (relaxase and MPF), predicted_mobilizable (relaxase only), or nonconjugative_or_no_mobility_markers_detected.

pct_multi_arg_ge2.description: Percentage of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry 2 or more acquired resistance genes. Co-location on one replicon, NOT co-transfer.

n_multi_arg_ge2.description: Count of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry 2 or more acquired resistance genes.

pct_multi_class_ge2.description: Percentage of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry resistance genes of 2 or more drug classes. Co-location on one replicon, NOT co-transfer.

n_multi_class_ge2.description: Count of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry resistance genes of 2 or more drug classes.

pct_multi_class_ge3.description: Percentage of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry resistance genes of 3 or more drug classes. Co-location on one replicon, NOT co-transfer.

n_multi_class_ge3.description: Count of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry resistance genes of 3 or more drug classes.

pct_arg_plus_metal.description: Percentage of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry at least one resistance gene AND a metal-tolerance determinant. Co-location on one replicon, NOT co-transfer.

n_arg_plus_metal.description: Count of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry at least one resistance gene AND a metal-tolerance determinant.

pct_arg_plus_biocide.description: Percentage of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry at least one resistance gene AND a biocide-tolerance determinant. Co-location on one replicon, NOT co-transfer.

n_arg_plus_biocide.description: Count of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry at least one resistance gene AND a biocide-tolerance determinant.

pct_arg_plus_virulence.description: Percentage of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry at least one resistance gene AND a virulence determinant. Co-location on one replicon, NOT co-transfer.

n_arg_plus_virulence.description: Count of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry at least one resistance gene AND a virulence determinant.

pct_arg_stress_virulence_triple.description: Percentage of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry resistance, stress and virulence determinants together. Co-location on one replicon, NOT co-transfer.

n_arg_stress_virulence_triple.description: Count of ARG-bearing plasmids in this mobility category that carry resistance, stress and virulence determinants together.
